title: ExplorerLayout
responsibility: Frames explorer pages with shared navigation and renders the supplied child content in the main area.

inputs.name: ExplorerLayout.base
inputs.description: The console's mount path, such as '/harness', that the header hands to its bar as the brand's link while no branch is resolved and as the address of search entries that resolve to no location. The header also joins it directly to the missing-history link's home path, which begins with a slash.

inputs.name: ExplorerLayout.problem
inputs.description: The failure message the host sets when the history or the open revision cannot be loaded, drawn as an alert notice in the header above the page. An empty string, which the host starts with, draws no notice.
examples: The history could not be loaded. Refresh the page to try again.
This revision could not be loaded. Refresh the page to try again.

inputs.name: ExplorerLayout.missing
inputs.type: { message: string; home: string | null } | null
inputs.description: The notice for an address that names nothing in this history; null draws no notice. Its message is drawn as an alert in the header, and a non-empty home adds an 'Open the newest commit' link to base joined with home.

examples.message: Commit 9f3c2a7 is not in this history.

inputs.name: ExplorerLayout.navbar
inputs.description: The explorer bar's inputs as the host resolves them: repository name, revision scope, index, branch commits, link and routing callbacks, and optional modules and search entries. The layout passes them on without reading them, and the header then draws the bar in place of its title row and its links to other views.

inputs.name: ExplorerLayout.children
inputs.description: The page content, a Svelte snippet that the layout renders with no arguments inside the main element below the shared header. The prop is required, and the main element holds nothing else.

outputs.name: ExplorerLayout
outputs.description: The rendered frame: an hx-div with class hx-shell holding the shared header, then an hx-main with class hx-main holding the supplied children. It has no component marker, because the file is a layout rather than a component.
